<translated_code>
#include <cstdio>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cstring>
#include <cctype>
#include <vector>
#include <queue>
#include <algorithm>
#include <climits>
using namespace std;
typedef long long ll;

// fast input
int read_int() {
    int x = 0, f = 1; char c = getchar();
    while (!isdigit(c)) { if (c == '-') f = -1; c = getchar(); }
    while (isdigit(c)) { x = x * 10 + c - '0'; c = getchar(); }
    return x * f;
}

char read_char() {
    char c = getchar();
    while (isspace(c)) c = getchar();
    return c;
}

void read_chars(char *s, int n) {
    char c = getchar();
    while (isspace(c)) c = getchar();
    int i = 0;
    while (i < n && !isspace(c)) {
        s[i++] = c;
        c = getchar();
    }
    // no null terminator needed, but we keep a buffer safe
    // s[i] = '\0'; // not required as we only use n chars
}

void read_ints(int *a, int n) {
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) a[i] = read_int();
}

// Edge for adjacency list (min cost flow)
struct Edge {
    int to, rev;
    int cap, flow, cost;
};

// Build graph from list of original edges (without reverse)
vector<vector<Edge>> compileWD(int n, vector<pair<pair<int,int>, pair<int,int>>>& edges_orig) {
    // edges_orig: pair<from,to>, pair<capacity,cost>
    vector<vector<Edge>> g(n);
    for (auto& e : edges_orig) {
        int from = e.first.first;
        int to = e.first.second;
        int cap = e.second.first;
        int cost = e.second.second;

        // forward edge
        Edge fwd;
        fwd.to = to;
        fwd.cap = cap;
        fwd.flow = 0;
        fwd.cost = cost;
        fwd.rev = g[to].size();
        g[from].push_back(fwd);

        // reverse edge
        Edge rev;
        rev.to = from;
        rev.cap = cap;
        rev.flow = cap;  // initially saturated
        rev.cost = -cost;
        rev.rev = g[from].size() - 1;
        g[to].push_back(rev);
    }
    return g;
}

// min cost flow: send up to maxf flow from s to t
ll solveMinCostFlow(vector<vector<Edge>>& g, int s, int t, ll maxf) {
    int n = g.size();
    ll flow = 0, cost = 0;
    vector<ll> pot(n, 0);
    const ll INF_LL = 1e18;
    while (maxf > 0) {
        vector<ll> dist(n, INF_LL);
        vector<int> prevv(n, -1), preve(n, -1);
        priority_queue<pair<ll,int>, vector<pair<ll,int>>, greater<pair<ll,int>>> pq;
        dist[s] = 0;
        pq.push({0, s});
        while (!pq.empty()) {
            auto p = pq.top(); pq.pop();
            int v = p.second;
            if (p.first > dist[v]) continue;
            for (int i = 0; i < (int)g[v].size(); ++i) {
                Edge& e = g[v][i];
                if (e.cap - e.flow > 0) {
                    ll nd = dist[v] + e.cost + pot[v] - pot[e.to];
                    if (dist[e.to] > nd) {
                        dist[e.to] = nd;
                        prevv[e.to] = v;
                        preve[e.to] = i;
                        pq.push({nd, e.to});
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        if (dist[t] == INF_LL) break;
        ll d = maxf;
        for (int v = t; v != s; v = prevv[v]) {
            d = min(d, (ll)(g[prevv[v]][preve[v]].cap - g[prevv[v]][preve[v]].flow));
        }
        maxf -= d;
        flow += d;
        cost += d * (dist[t] + pot[t]); // pot[s] == 0
        for (int v = t; v != s; v = prevv[v]) {
            Edge& e = g[prevv[v]][preve[v]];
            e.flow += d;
            g[v][e.rev].flow -= d;
        }
        for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
            if (dist[i] < INF_LL) pot[i] += dist[i];
        }
    }
    return cost;
}

int main() {
    int n = read_int();
    char *s = new char[n];
    read_chars(s, n);

    // frequency count
    int f[26] = {0};
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) f[s[i]-'a']++;
    for (int i = 0; i < 26; ++i) {
        if (f[i] > n/2) {
            puts("-1");
            delete[] s;
            return 0;
        }
    }

    int *a = new int[n];
    read_ints(a, n);

    // swap to make a[i] <= a[n-1-i]
    for (int i = 0; i < n/2; ++i) {
        if (a[i] > a[n-1-i]) {
            swap(a[i], a[n-1-i]);
            swap(s[i], s[n-1-i]);
        }
    }

    // build edges
    int src = n, sink = n+1;
    vector<pair<pair<int,int>, pair<int,int>>> es;
    for (int i = 0; i < n/2; ++i) {
        es.push_back({{src, i}, {1, 0}});
        es.push_back({{n-1-i, sink}, {1, 0}});
        for (int j = 0; j < n/2; ++j) {
            if (s[i] != s[n-1-j]) {
                int cost = (i == j) ? 0 : a[i];
                es.push_back({{i, n-1-j}, {1, cost}});
            }
        }
    }

    int total_nodes = sink + 1;
    vector<vector<Edge>> g = compileWD(total_nodes, es);

    // sum of a
    ll sum_a = 0;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) sum_a += a[i];

    ll mincost = solveMinCostFlow(g, src, sink, n);
    ll ans = sum_a - mincost;
    printf("%lld\n", ans);

    delete[] s;
    delete[] a;
    return 0;
}
